messages.author: Ilse Varga
messages.text: Hi! I was charged twice for my March invoice. Can you take a look?

messages.author: Tomás Reyes
messages.text: Hi Ilse, sorry about that. Could you share the invoice number?

messages.author: Tomás Reyes
messages.text: Thanks. I can see the duplicate charge and have started a refund.

messages.author: Tomás Reyes
messages.text: It should reach your card within 3 to 5 business days.

messages.author: Ilse Varga
messages.text: That's great, thank you for sorting it out so quickly!
